title: Associate Product Manager Trailer Business
description:
**Position Summary**
The Associate Product Manager will support the Trailer Product Management team in managing the product portfolio across its lifecycle. The role acts as a key interface between Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Sales, Quality, and Finance to ensure effective execution of product changes, VaVe initiatives, portfolio optimization, ramp-up monitoring, and lifecycle-related activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, collaborative, and comfortable working across global and regional teams. The role requires strong ownership, process discipline, and the ability to translate portfolio data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Lifecycle & Portfolio Management**

* Support Product Managers in managing the complete product lifecycle from market introduction through phase-out and end-of-life.
* Maintain portfolio overviews and support portfolio optimization activities focused on profitability, complexity reduction, and strategic fit.
* Coordinate phase-in, phase-out, and ramp-up tracking activities with relevant stakeholders.
* Support optimization of wiring and trailer product portfolio, including process ownership for selected portfolio adaptation topics.
* Ensure product data accuracy and maintain lifecycle-related documentation and tracking files.

**Change Management & Process Coordination**

* Coordinate and run product Change Requests (CRs) through established business and engineering change processes.
* Lead implementation of engineering and product changes across Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Sales.
* Ensure timely communication, follow-up, and escalation for product-related change topics.

**Commercial excellence**

* Support data-driven decision-making through analysis of product, sales, profitability, complexity, and lifecycle data.
* Support the VaVe pipeline and maintain a structured overview of active and potential VaVe topics.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Purchasing, Operations, and Product Management to identify value engineering and cost optimization opportunities.

**Analysis & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain reports and dashboards using Power BI, Excel, and relevant business systems.
* Analyze portfolio gaps, product performance, ramp-up status, LTB stock, and phase-in/phase-out progress.

**Cross-Functional Interface & Team Support**

* Act as an interface between Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality, and Finance.
* Support Global Product Managers in day-to-day portfolio management activities, stakeholder follow-up, and preparation of decision documents.

**Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical, Electrical, Electronics Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering.
* Masters degree or MBA in Product Management, Marketing, Operations, or Business Administration is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 3-4 years of experience in Product Management, Product Engineering, Project Management, Portfolio Management, Sales Engineering, or Automotive Industry roles.
* Experience in commercial vehicles, trailer systems, braking systems, wiring solutions, automotive components, or industrial manufacturing is preferred.
* Exposure to product lifecycle management, change management, VaVe, business case preparation, or portfolio optimization is desirable.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Understanding of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) principles and product portfolio processes.
* Experience with Change Request (CR) and engineering change management processes.
* Knowledge of Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VaVe), cost optimization, and business case development.
* Strong analytical skills with advanced Microsoft Excel capability.
* Experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools.
* Ability to analyze product portfolio data, profitability, sales trends, product complexity, and lifecycle KPIs.
* Hands on experience with Creo with R&D background / wiring Harness experience is plus.

title: Ecommerce Manager

* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

title: Group Product Manager, Emerging Solutions

**Group Product Manager, Emerging Solutions**
.

Our amazing teams serve Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. **What You'll Do**

* Set the multi-year vision and go-to-market roadmap for Sales Module, with agentic experiences at the center, and be accountable for its adoption and quality
* Lead the shift to agent-ready delivery: composable tools and actions that customers can bring into the AI assistants, agents, and workflows they already rely on, using RainFocus Nexus and MCP Profiles
* Own the experience across every surface, including native RainFocus, Salesforce, and agent-driven channels such as Slack and Claude, so it feels consistent wherever reps and partners work
* Direct our external development partner on the Salesforce app
* Work with product and engineering leaders to sharpen the data behind the product, so it powers better AI-driven insights across the platform
* Design for five core personas: account executives, event managers, sales leaders, digital marketers, and channel sales managers

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years in enterprise B2B SaaS product management, including 2+ years leading product managers or complex, multi-product teams
* Deep expertise in sales and revenue operations and workflows: how enterprise sales teams manage accounts, territories, quota, pipeline, and partners. Event technology experience is valuable but does not substitute
* Deep Salesforce ecosystem knowledge (Sales Cloud, AppExchange patterns, Canvas, Lightning Web Components, APIs, OAuth/SSO)
* Experience shipping AI-native and agentic product capabilities, such as LLM-based inference, conversational assistants, or agents that take action on a user's behalf
* Hands-on experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including the differences between an MCP server, an MCP App, and a plugin
* Comfort with a phased, evidence-gated approach, where commitments follow early proof
* A track record of directing external agencies or integrators to deliver on schedule
* Domain expertise in sales enablement, revenue operations, martech, CRM integrations, or event technology

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in event management or event marketing technology
* Experience with acquired codebases, legacy migrations, or sunset plans.
* Familiarity with the revenue and conversation-intelligence landscape.
* Exposure to entity matching, non-Salesforce CRMs, or agent marketplaces such as Claude and ChatGPT.

**Why work at RainFocus?**
At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.
  
  
As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities.
  
  
What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

title: Product Line Specialist
description:
Requisition Number: 77922
   

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.
   

  

 Join us.**
 Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
   

  

 How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
   

  

 At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
   

  

 Come break through with us.
   

  

 Corning’s Businesses Are Ever\-evolving To Best Serve Our Customers, Industries, And Consumers. Today, We Accelerate And Transform Life Sciences, Mobile Consumer Electronics, Optical Communications, Display, Automotive, And Solar Markets. We Are Changing The World With
   

  

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage\-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low\-cost solar energy solutions


 Purpose of Position
   

  

* Develops and executes a product line strategy that supports the achievement of desired product line sales growth and profitability


 Major Responsibility
   

  

 Works Closely With, Or Leads, a Cross\-functional Product Team Consisting Of Functional Leads From Development, Product Engineering, Applications Engineering, Manufacturing, Marketing And/or Sales To
   

  

* Develop the product or product line’s market value proposition and pricing strategy.
* Develop and execute the product line planning process, including the identification of critical projects to be undertaken for the year.
* Find the optimal solution (balancing the needs of Corning and the customer) to all product issues related to performance (i.e., specs, attributes, services), quality, share growth, customer needs (contract management)
* Create an intellectual property and standards strategy for the product line.
* Understand downstream market requirements and assess competitive threats and implications for the business.
* Create long\-term forecasting plans.
* Works with Program Management or New Business Development to ‘receive’ new products, as appropriate.
* Develops a compelling market value proposition that differentiates Corning’s products and services in the marketplace.
* Develops the product line strategy and manages the product line through the stages of innovation, from product concept through commercialization and life\-cycle management, as appropriate depending on the stage of handoff from Program Management or New Business Development
* May manage a portfolio of markets, in the case where the product line’s products hold different positions within the markets they reach.
* Identifies the best mix for the market(s) through effective segmentation and portfolio rationalization.
* Optimizes inventory management related to the product line by coordinating information flow, as needed, between Forecasting, Sales, Manufacturing, and other parties as needed.
* May get involved in supply chain disruption issues to influence or make decisions on global order and Development/Manufacturing prioritization.
* Works with Manufacturing and Sales to identify opportunities to reduce complexity and cost reduction in the manufacturing process both at Corning’s plant(s) and the customer site, as appropriate.
* Works with the Standards group to set and drive the standards strategy for the product line.
* Addresses new product/special requests by developing a business case (including P\&L and balance sheet implications) to determine the feasibility and pricing requirements of the requests.
* Owns and optimizes, or may work with the Pricing Manger to optimize, pricing levels by setting floor price, establishing pricing structure, optimizing product premiums, and ensuring value received for product line
* Works with Account Management to develop value propositions that improve margins for Corning’s products and services and enable new/enhanced selling opportunities with customers.
* Manages the obsolescence process, as necessary, to extract maximum value through the end of the product’s lifecycle.
* May oversee, develop, and direct a Product Line team.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree \- Technical (engineering degree or other formal engineering education)
* MBA desired
* Intermediate Project Management Skills and Practices
* Product / Process Knowledge
* Customer Knowledge


**Required Competency (Skills, Knowledge And Abilities)**
* Demonstrated track record of managing projects.
* Demonstrated track record of leading and/or actively participating in multi\-functional teams.
* Fluent English written and spoken. Knowledge of additional Asian language knowledge is a plus.
* Good knowledge of Excel spreadsheets and MS Office in general
* Optical Industry Acumen is a plus.
* Technology around the Data Center including cabling and actives/networking are a plus.

**Job Description \& Summary:**

  
   

  




 PwC's Advisory practice works with the world's leading global custodians, asset servicers, and asset managers to implement front\-to\-back investment management and order management platforms. This Business Analyst role focuses on the capital markets domain – covering front\-office trading, order management, compliance, derivatives, and trade lifecycle through to settlement.
 


  
   

  




 We are looking for individuals with experience working within or alongside Global Capability Centers (GCCs) of major financial institutions – particularly those that have supported OMS/EMS implementations, trading operations, derivatives processing, or front\-office technology programs.

 \- Support requirements for T\+1 settlement readiness and related platform transformation initiatives
 


  
   

  


**Integration \& Operating Model Design:**

  
   

  




 \- Define data integration requirements between front\-office OMS and downstream middle/back\-office systems (accounting, reconciliation, data platforms)
 


  
   

  




 \- Document interface specifications for system\-to\-system integrations across the front\-to\-back chain
 


  
   

  




 \- Support Future State Operating Model (FSOM) design and documentation for front\-office service transitions
 


  
   

  




 \- Develop Service Level Documentation defining service scope, KPIs, SLAs, and operational processes

 \- Analyze requirements for OTC derivatives processing – collateral, margin, and settlement workflows

 \- Support requirements for UMR compliance – initial margin, variation margin, SIMM calculations
